items.name: GA Cubers Park Be Quiet 2026
items.information: This competition has **only** Blindfolded and Fewest Moves events and is not suitable for most first-time competitors. If you are interested in competing in regular speedsolving events, you may want to look into [Clocking in Cobb 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClockinginCobb2026) two weeks before or one of the Atlanta-area weeknight competitions taking place throughout the fall. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GACubersBigBlindQualifier2026#72008-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)

venue.name: Blue Flames Sporting Club
venue.address: Whitley Rd, Newcastle upon Tyne NE12 9SF

items.information: **PLEASE NOTE:** This is a Blindfolded specialist competition, there will be no regular speedsolving events held. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. **Spectators may attend for free!** Although as this is a blindfolded specialist competition we will ask for silence during the majority of the event. The winner of **3x3 Blindfolded** will be announced as the winner of the competition.
